title: Intertwiners of representations of exceptional type quantum affine superalgebras
summary: We give explicit formulas for the smallest non-trivial irreducible representation $V$ of quantum affine superalgebras in types D$_{2\vert 1;α}$, $\dim V=18$ (in the all-fermionic parity), F$_{3\vert 1}$, $\dim V=41$ (in the distinguished parity), and G$_{2\vert 1}$, $\dim V=32$ (in the distinguished parity), both in the Drinfeld-Jimbo and in the new Drinfeld realizations. We use this information to obtain an explicit expression for the corresponding $R$-matrices.
